what_it_is.prose: Mahindra Defence Systems Limited (MDS) is the defence arm of India's Mahindra Group, serving all three branches of the Indian armed forces as well as paramilitary and police forces. Its portfolio spans land systems — armoured and mine-protected vehicles including the Armoured Light Specialist Vehicle (ALSV), Mine-Protected Vehicles, Light Specialist Vehicles and bullet-proof vehicles inducted by the Indian Army — naval systems, defence electronics, and composite structures for defence and space applications. In the naval domain MDS was awarded a ₹1,349.95 crore contract on 27 August 2021 to manufacture 14 Integrated Anti-Submarine Warfare Defence Suites (IADS) for Indian Navy warships, described as the first such system developed by an Indian company for the Navy, and it also produces torpedo-defence systems, decoys and torpedo launchers. Its defence-electronics work has included a joint venture with Telephonics Corporation of the USA. Within the military-aerospace context, Mahindra's relevance is primarily as a private-sector defence prime and Tier-1 supplier: it manufactures composite aerostructures and sub-systems and is positioned within India's broader aerospace and defence manufacturing ecosystem (the Mahindra Group's aerospace activities have historically included aerostructures and small-aircraft ventures). Public, primary evidence specific to Mahindra Defence's military-aircraft/aerospace subsystems is thinner than for its land and naval systems, so this entry is tiered B and leans on its documented armoured-vehicle and naval-ASW record.

deployments_procurement.summary: Mahindra Defence's strongest documented India footprint is in armoured vehicles for the Indian Army and paramilitary forces and in naval anti-submarine warfare systems for the Indian Navy. The flagship naval contract is the ₹1,349.95 crore IADS award (14 systems, August 2021). Its ALSV and specialist vehicles have been inducted by the Indian Army.

faq.question: What does Mahindra Defence Systems make?
faq.answer: Mahindra Defence Systems is the Mahindra Group's defence business, supplying all three Indian services plus paramilitary and police forces. Its main product lines are armoured and mine-protected vehicles (including the Armoured Light Specialist Vehicle, ALSV), naval anti-submarine warfare systems, torpedo-defence and decoy/torpedo launchers, defence electronics, and composite structures for defence and space applications.

faq.question: What is Mahindra Defence's biggest naval contract?
faq.answer: In August 2021 Mahindra Defence won a ₹1,349.95 crore contract to manufacture 14 Integrated Anti-Submarine Warfare Defence Suites (IADS) for Indian Navy warships — described as the first system of its kind developed by an Indian company for the Navy, comprising underwater detection sensor arrays and signal-processing to identify and neutralise submarine threats across small, medium and large vessels.
